ConnectionStrings._comment_DefaultConnection: REQUIRED while Database:Enabled is true: Database connection string

Database._comment_Enabled: false runs the service without a database: no connection string, migrations or readiness check; any query answers 503. The job server and an outbox bus go off with it

Infisical._comment_Enabled: false reads nothing from the store: every value comes from the files and the environment
Infisical._comment: Secrets are read from SharedPath, then ServicePath, and override the rest of configuration. ClientId and ClientSecret (the machine identity) never live in this file: pass Infisical__ClientId and Infisical__ClientSecret as environment variables.
Infisical._comment_ProjectId: REQUIRED outside Local: the Infisical project holding the secrets
Infisical._comment_EnvironmentSlug: REQUIRED outside Local: dev, staging or prod; set it in appsettings.<Environment>.json
Infisical._note_Defaults: OPTIONAL keys, set only to override the defaults: HostUri (https://app.infisical.com), SharedPath (/), ServicePath (/servicenameorcustom), Optional (true in Local, false elsewhere: a deployed service must not start without its secrets), ReloadSeconds (300: how often a running service reads the store again; 0 at startup only)

Vault._comment_Enabled: false reads nothing from Vault: every value comes from the files and the environment
Vault._comment: Secrets are read from the KV version 2 secrets SharedPath, then ServicePath, and override the rest of configuration. Token, or RoleId and SecretId (an AppRole), never live in this file: pass Vault__Token or Vault__RoleId and Vault__SecretId as environment variables.
Vault._comment_Address: REQUIRED outside Local: where Vault runs, such as https://vault.example.com:8200
Vault._note_Defaults: OPTIONAL keys, set only to override the defaults: Mount (secret), SharedPath (shared), ServicePath (servicenameorcustom), Optional (true in Local, false elsewhere), ReloadSeconds (300; 0 at startup only)

InternalApi._comment_ApiKey: System API key for inter-service communication, at least 16 characters. Empty: every call with an API key is refused

Permissions._comment_Source: claims: the permissions of the token, or those the gateway forwards; remote: asked from a separate service, below

Remote._comment_BaseAddress: For remote: where the permission service runs, such as http://permissions:8080/
Remote._comment_Path: Answers the user's permissions as a JSON array of strings; called with the internal key and the caller
Remote._comment_CacheSeconds: How long an answer is reused per user: a permission taken away stops working within it

HangfireSettings._comment_Enabled: false runs no job server and no dashboard, and drops the settings below from validation
HangfireSettings._comment_DashboardPassword: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: Min 12 chars for Basic Auth validation

ClickHouse._comment_Enabled: false: opening a connection answers 503, the connection string is not required, readiness does not check it
ClickHouse._comment_ConnectionString: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: Host=...;Port=8123;Username=...;Password=...;Database=...; pass it as ClickHouse__ConnectionString

MongoDB._comment_Enabled: false: asking for the database answers 503, the connection string is not required, readiness does not check it
MongoDB._comment_ConnectionString: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: mongodb://user:password@host:27017/?authSource=admin; pass it as MongoDB__ConnectionString
MongoDB._comment_Database: The service's own database; every collection it uses lives there

Email._comment_Provider: Smtp or GraphApi: the transport is chosen once, at startup

Smtp._comment_From: REQUIRED with Smtp: the address messages come from
Smtp._comment_Secure: true: TLS on connect on any port; otherwise 465 is TLS on connect, 587 STARTTLS. Username and Password, from the secret store, only for a server that wants a sign-in

Sandbox._comment_Enabled: Outside Production every message goes to ReceiverAddress whatever this says; in Production only while it is true

Email._note_GraphApi: With GraphApi: a GraphApi section with TenantId, ClientId, ClientSecret (from the secret store) and SenderEmail, the mailbox messages are sent from

S3._comment_Enabled: false keeps nothing: writes are ignored and reads return empty, so the service runs before it has a bucket
S3._note_Credentials: AccessKey and SecretKey as S3__AccessKey and S3__SecretKey, never in this file

RabbitMq._comment_Enabled: false registers a no-op bus: publishing and sending do nothing, and a critical line is logged at startup
RabbitMq._note_Defaults: OPTIONAL keys, set only to override the defaults: Host (localhost), UserName and Password (guest; pass real credentials as RabbitMq__UserName and RabbitMq__Password, never in this file), PurgeOnStartup (false), RetryLimit (3), RetryInitialIntervalSeconds (1), RetryIntervalIncrementSeconds (2)

AuthCookies._comment_SameSite: Lax when the frontend is on the same site as the API (one domain or its subdomains, any port); None for a frontend on another domain, which needs HTTPS. See docs/architecture/authentication-and-permissions.md
AuthCookies._comment_ServedOverHttps: true when clients reach the service over HTTPS, here or at a proxy in front: the token cookies are then always Secure. SameSite=None refuses to start without it
AuthCookies._comment_RequireCsrfHeader: A POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE authenticated by a token cookie needs the X-CSRF header (any value) from the frontend; a request with an Authorization header or an API key does not

Cors._comment_AllowedOrigins: REQUIRED for production: Array of allowed origins for CORS
Cors._comment_AllowedMethods: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed HTTP methods (default: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS)
Cors._comment_AllowCredentials: OPTIONAL: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, auth headers)
Cors._comment_PreflightMaxAge: OPTIONAL: Preflight cache duration in seconds (default: 3600)
Cors._comment_AllowedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed headers (if empty, allows any)
Cors._comment_ExposedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of exposed headers (if empty, allows any)

Swagger._comment_PublicServers: The servers of the Swagger documents, each { "Url": an absolute URL, "Description" }; none for a local run
Swagger._comment_ScrubPatterns: Regular expressions removed from the descriptions of the documents, such as the ids of a tracker
